body:
Add the previously undelivered LoginClusterStatus and AutoArray/AutoList regression checks above [Archive #58](https://github.com/SWG-Source/client-tools/pull/58), which already includes [wire PR23](https://github.com/SWG-Source/client-tools/pull/23). The two original test commit units change **five files, +256/−35**, with no production or workflow changes. The second commit retains only the test/runner/README portion of the container-count change; its source correction is already in the base. All final harness files match their original bytes. The master diff also includes #23 and #58; use the [incremental test comparison](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/compare/085a62e3358e7b51c5198c93bb1581864020c3fb...d8cb69a4b50fbbb23e09a8cc6bc97cedc6d9a185), and merge or reconcile those prerequisites first.

Nine galaxy-list checks compare two distinct 14-field records, empty/two-record lists and an exact iterator boundary against literal legacy Win32 bytes. Signed boundaries, high unsigned values, unequal addresses and opposing flags make width/order errors observable. Twelve container checks cover 0/1/3 initialized byte elements, seeded output prefixes, literal unsigned-32-bit counts and complete decoding. Expected bytes are not generated by candidate roundtrips.

Run with Python 3, clang++, MinGW-w64 and Wine from the checkout:

```sh
python3 tools/test-wire-compatibility/run.py --bits 32 --require-current-coverage --artifacts artifacts/wire-32
python3 tools/test-wire-compatibility/run.py --bits 64 --require-current-coverage --artifacts artifacts/wire-64
```

Select the README's compatible Wine prefix/architecture if needed; use fresh artifact directories. The runner targets the selected Windows ABI and checks 70 common runtime results plus seven Win64-only results, then adds the compile-time wire-width check: **71 Win32 / 78 Win64**. Known Win32 skips must match exactly; unknown/duplicate absence or skip notices fail, and current-coverage mode forbids absent helpers. Artifact output retains commands, exits, raw diagnostics, translation-unit hashes and staged source hashes. The exact submitted head passed the inherited [fork wire CI](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/actions/runs/36898832109), with 71/71 Win32 and 78/78 Win64 checks. Its master-PR trigger applies to this submission.

The [original galaxy fixture report](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/blob/115d618f039a7fb36350611c104e9cb25d45e60c/review/client-x64/vendor-next/login-cluster-next/REPORT.md) records the earlier 59/66 candidate totals, independent stock-Win32 literals, three failed Win64 native-width encoding controls and 14 verdict-control cases. The [expanded source record](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/commit/4d3009851ec6cdd005ef41c9dc1fc666dffe7e64) records 71/78 candidate and 68 stock-Win32 checks. Later preserved [Win32](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/blob/eebb8062fcb9c323f5d4f2fff9093cf94b68839c/review/client-x64/pr-ready-next/archive-storage/historical-unicode/final-wire32/commands-32.jsonl) and [Win64](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/blob/eebb8062fcb9c323f5d4f2fff9093cf94b68839c/review/client-x64/pr-ready-next/archive-storage/historical-unicode/wire64/commands-64.jsonl) commands retain those totals and matching compiled inputs, including documented template syntax edits. The current fork run above rechecks the portable matrix; no new MSVC or gameplay run was performed.

The existing harness shims base construction and registration: LoginClusterStatus uses real constructors and serializers, but the base omits command CRC registration. This covers bounded 14-field serializer data, not the real message base, packet framing, dispatch, a 12-field variant or live login. Small-container checks do not establish actual oversized-container rejection. Portable Wine results do not establish MSVC/STLport or full-client behavior. Historical failed links and controls remain failures; no new providers or broader CI composition are included.

[Review packet and exact source identities](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/blob/16436319afab9fe4c32fd71dc48c5068cde009ea/review/client-x64/pr-ready-next/wire-regressions/RESULTS.md).
title: Cover galaxy-list and ordinary-container wire encodings
